messages:
alex_k: Quick heads-up — our sampleapp is hitting a weird SSE reorder after a client reconnect in prod. Local can't repro reliably.
alex_k: Repro steps: 1) start streaming gen, 2) kill client TCP for ~200ms, 3) client reconnects and resume token present, 4) chunks replay but order is wrong (partial tokens first). Logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T15:12:03Z] chunk seq=102 part=1 data=\"Hello wor\"
[2026-03-15T15:12:03Z] disconnect: client reset
[2026-03-15T15:12:03Z] reconnect: resume_token=rt_abc123
[2026-03-15T15:12:03Z] chunk seq=102 part=2 data=\"ld\"
[2026-03-15T15:12:03Z] chunk seq=101 part=1 data=\"Previous\"
```
alex_k: Looks like the server re-sent older seq=101 after resuming and client appended out of order.

maria_r: Hmm. Are we using Last-Event-ID or our resume token? Which SDK?

amid: (typo) sorry — samir will know.
samir: It's node-sdk sampleapp v0.9.2. We use custom resume_token header, not Last-Event-ID. The client calls /stream?resume=rt_abc123 and server tries to replay from the token.

samir: My hunch: auth refresh flow triggers a short reconnect and the proxy's replay queue mixes queued fragments from the old connection with replayed fragments from the resume window.

dennis: Can you paste the SSE fragments as they arrive on the wire? Need to see event boundaries. If fragments are split across frames the reassembly logic might mis-order when reconciling resume + buffered queue.

alex_k: Pasted minimal wire trace above. Notice part numbering; the app-level chunk seq is reliable but parts arrive interleaved.

tasha: We recently changed the proxy to ack tail chunks async to improve throughput — that could explain stale queue flushing after reconnect. cc @eng-runtime.

samir: Quick workaround client-side: buffer fragments by (seq, part) and apply ordering before emitting tokens. It's a small change in reconstructChunk() — will open PR.

maria_r: Longer-term: we should standardize a strict chunk-sequence header (X-Chunk-Seq) across runtime/proxy/sdk so both sides can deterministically reorder on resume.

dennis: Agreed. Also add Last-Event-ID fallback for browsers (some clients only implement that).

ci-bot: deploy: sampleapp/node-sdk/0.9.3 -> canary at 2026-03-15T15:14:20Z by tasha :rocket:

tasha: I opened a tiny client patch that buffers on reconnect and uses the sequence header. PR: https://git.internal/r/sampleapp/42 (tests included).

samir: Nice — can we add a flaky integration test that simulates TCP flaps and verifies final token ordering?

tasha: Yep. I added a deterministic flappy-proxy test harness (toggle latency and drop). Will push test in the same PR.

alex_k: Thanks — will deploy canary to the customer repro env and report back. If it fixes, we should ship a node-sdk patch and a runtime config change note. :thumbsup:

maria_r: Also file a short doc in /docs/streaming-retries.md explaining expected behavior for resume vs replay — saves future triage time.

alex_k: Filed doc issue #678. Will update when canary results come in.
